title: Portugal: The Art of Well-Being
summary: Step away from your usual routine and settle into a gentler rhythm in central Portugal. This retreat pairs morning yoga with walks in nature, a cycling excursion, and time to rest by the pool. You’ll also spend a day volunteering with a local community organization and share quieter moments through journaling, sound healing, and chanting by the fire. With one hotel as your base, there’s time to feel at home while experiencing a different side of Portugal.

sections.title: Portugal: The Art of Well-Being
sections.subtitle: Six days of movement, reflection, and connection in central Portugal
sections.html: Step away from your usual routine and settle into a gentler rhythm in central Portugal. This retreat pairs morning yoga with walks in nature, a cycling excursion, and time to rest by the pool. You’ll also spend a day volunteering with a local community organization and share quieter moments through journaling, sound healing, and chanting by the fire. With one hotel as your base, there’s time to feel at home while experiencing a different side of Portugal.

sections.title: Day 1 — Arrive and Unwind
sections.html: Arrive at either Lisbon or Porto Airport, where your guide will welcome you and arrange the transfer to your hotel in central Portugal. Lisbon and Porto are Portugal’s two largest cities; for this trip, they serve as arrival points before you continue to your retreat base. Settle into your room, take a first look at your surroundings, and enjoy dinner on your own. Overnight at the hotel.

sections.title: Day 2 — Find Your Rhythm in Nature
sections.html: Begin the morning with an approximately 50-minute yoga session, followed by breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, head into a nearby natural park for a guided hike and a chance to experience the landscape on foot. Enjoy lunch on your own, then return to the hotel for an afternoon by the pool. Dinner is on your own, and you’ll spend the night at the hotel.

sections.title: Day 3 — Connect with the Community
sections.html: Start with an approximately 50-minute yoga session and breakfast. Today’s focus is on giving back: join a volunteer activity with a local community organization, which could be a school, a retirement home, or another group selected for the program. After lunch on your own, return to the hotel and enjoy an early dinner. In the evening, take part in a sound healing session designed as a quiet close to the day. Overnight at the hotel.

sections.title: Day 4 — Cycle, Reflect, and Gather by the Fire
sections.html: Begin with an approximately 50-minute yoga session and breakfast before setting out on a cycling excursion through the surrounding area. Bring a picnic lunch and pause during the ride for journaling, giving yourself time to take in what you’ve seen and reflect on the retreat so far. Return to the hotel for dinner, then gather by the fire for an evening of mantra chanting. Overnight at the hotel.

sections.title: Day 5 — One More Day Outdoors
sections.html: After an approximately 50-minute yoga session and breakfast, return to the natural park for another hike. A second day on the trails offers a chance to experience the area at a more familiar, relaxed pace. Have lunch on your own, then spend the afternoon enjoying the hotel’s swimming facilities. Dinner is on your own, followed by your final overnight stay.

sections.title: Day 6 — Depart Portugal
sections.html: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before transferring to Lisbon or Porto Airport, according to your flight arrangements. Your retreat concludes with time to carry its slower rhythm home with you.

sections.title: What is included
sections.html:
What’s included

  • Roundtrip international airfare

  • Five nights of hotel accommodation

  • Daily hotel breakfast

  • Airport arrival and departure transfers

  • Welcome by a guide on arrival

  • Four morning yoga sessions of approximately 50 minutes each

  • Two natural park hikes

  • Local volunteer activity

  • Sound healing session

  • Cycling excursion and time for journaling

  • Evening mantra chanting

  • Access to the hotel’s swimming facilities

What’s not included

  • Lunches on Days 2, 3, and 5

  • Dinners on Days 1, 2, and 5

  • Personal expenses and optional activities

  • Travel insurance
